description: This file is a JavaScript module that defines a web scraper function for the website 'omnivorescookbook.com'. It uses 'request' to fetch HTML content and 'cheerio' to parse and extract recipe data, which it structures into a RecipeSchema object.

methods.name: omnivorescookbook
methods.description: A function that takes a URL, fetches the webpage, parses the recipe data, and returns a Promise resolving to a structured Recipe object.
